verdict.rationale: Isaac Sim exposes Python packages for scripting/composing apps and supports headless/standalone operation and ROS 2 control, implying broad API-driven access, but no evidence explicitly confirms full parity between UI and API functionality, and probes show no public REST/OpenAPI surface. missing for 10: explicit documentation of UI-API parity, a public REST/GraphQL API spec, and independent confirmation that all UI-exposed features (e.g., asset import GUI tools, robot tuning UI) are scriptable via API.
